csv_project_name: AE for Concrete Pavement Phase 4 Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Military Affairs requests selecting an A/E to provide design through construction administration services as indicated in the DFD Policy and Procedure Manual for Architects/Engineers and Consultants and the DFD AE Contract for Professional Services for the Fort McCoy MATES Replace Concrete Pavement Phase 4 project. To complete phase 4 of the concrete replacement at Ft McCoy MATES the following scopes of work will be required. a. Repair/replace concrete pavement for Phase 4 of the MATES parking lot project. b. Repair/replace underground utilities and infrastructure as necessary based on condition inspections. c. Replace existing fence running along the eastern and northern boundary of the proposed project. Reinstall fence embedded within the new concrete pavement. d. Repair and replace bollards at building overhead doors.
